title: Majority of returning personnel transferred within the division

paragraphs.text: After the return to San Diego, the majority of officers and men were transferred to other units throughout the division. No individual dates or numerical total are given.

notes: August 8 is the return date used to position this entry, not a documented transfer date. The source gives no end date, named recipients, individual destinations or numerical total.
researchStatus: Existing OCR; aggregate statement, precise dates unresolved.
